archive.catalogue_description: Description The Cemetery By: TheMightyDud You were a gravedigger before the war. Now that its over you have thousands of dead nazis in your backyard. Every five minutes text will appear in the upper_left hand corner telling you how many minutes you’ve survived. A yellow word will be included in the text, post the word in the comments on my map at ZombieModding.com to prove how far you got. Der Riese Style Map Size: Small Difficulty: Medium Features: Kino Style Teleporter Custom Powerups Time Keeper Zombie Counter All Four Perk Machines PaP Secret Area Buyable Powerups Buyable Turrets Custom Weapons
